name: Mucus drip test
subtitle: timing how a mucus thread breaks into drops

effects.effect: a thin stream of liquid breaks itself into a row of drops

effect: a thin stream of liquid breaks itself into a row of drops
how: People with cystic fibrosis or COPD land in hospital when their lung mucus thickens and gets infected, but measuring its stickiness takes a lab instrument. A thread of coughed-up mucus squeezed from a nozzle breaks itself into drops, and the stickier and stretchier it is, the longer the thread holds before beading; a phone camera times the break, warning of a flare-up days early so treatment can start at home.
obstacle: Mucus varies wildly even within one cough, so a single reading may be too noisy to trust.
why: Home warning of flare-ups for millions living with chronic lung disease.
real: Capillary-breakup (CaBER) rheometry of COPD sputum has been studied as an exacerbation biomarker, but no smartphone or point-of-care breakup test was found.
